r2LandedHitRecoveryEligibility.rootCause: full runtime gated hit recovery on damage-formula readiness while non-damage projection gated it on transaction presence, so unresolved deterministic damage inputs produced different resource ledgers and downstream vital settlements
r2LandedHitRecoveryEligibility.nativeConclusion: DamageElement.Parse stores recoverSP, petRecoverSP and recoverInterval; the local AliveElementSystem branch calls ExecuteDamageElement@0x13151F0 at 0x131935A, verifies executor and source EPlayerNetworkState.LocalControlled, then calls DamageElement.RecoverSP@0x138EEE0 at 0x1319594. Missing simulator formula inputs leave damage unresolved without suppressing verified recovery after those authority gates.
